import pandas as pd
print(Path("summary.txt").read_text()[2000:])
table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
print(table.to_string(index=False))

source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
source = source.replace("go.Scatter(", "go.Bar(", 3)
source = source.replace("y=df['Trade_Balance_2021'],\n    name='2020", "y=df['Trade_Balance_2020'],\n    name='2020")
source = source.replace("y=df['Trade_Balance_2020'],\n    name='2021", "y=df['Trade_Balance_2021'],\n    name='2021")
source = source.replace("title='GDP Growth (%)',", "title='Trade Balance (Billion USD)',", 1)
source = source.replace("yaxis2=dict(\n        title='Trade Balance (Billion USD)',", "yaxis2=dict(\n        title='GDP Growth (%)',")
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
print("Trace checks:", [(t.type, t.name, list(t.y), t.yaxis) for t in fig.data])
print("Axes:", fig.layout.yaxis.title.text, fig.layout.yaxis2.title.text)
